top_signal.title: Advice to address clients on a hiatus for personal reasons…
top_signal.summary: hey all - so a little backstory, I have ran my own business for a little over seven years..In that time, a lot in my personal life has changed and most of it not for the good, particularly in the last couple..I really bent myself over backwards to keep pouring myself into it, all the while slipping further away from myself and taking care of my own health and digging into a deeper financial hole in the process. it all came to a head recently and I frankly had a straight up mental backdown from all of the financial pressure taking such a toll on me. it’s been a real hard road but I pretty much hit the absolute bottom and landed on my ass hitting every branch on the way down. i have been struggling to come to terms with the situation but i had to remove myself entirely to selfishly focus on my own wellbeing for a change because the rate I was going at was slowly killing me inside. My work wasn’t my best, I wasn’t as motivated, I was slowly starting to truly resent what I did because I’d lost so much joy in what I did. I was barely surviving.   i have kept my head fairly low to the ground about this situation aside from a few close friends and family, but I am in a real gutted position. I obviously never intended to find myself in this situation and feel an incredible amount of guilt that I am going to probably have to close the doors and take this on the chin. many have become great clients I consider good friends, some have become family. i know I need to address this publicly
